title: The Moon and the Night Sky
summary: Why the Moon seems to change shape, the month, and patterns of stars.

cbse.chapter: Our Wondrous World (2025) Ch 9: Rhythms of Nature

objectives: I can explain why the Moon shines.
I can name the phases of the Moon.
I can explain why the phases repeat about every month.
misconceptions: The Earth’s shadow causes the Moon’s phases.
The Moon makes its own light.
The Moon is only in the sky at night.
